verdicts.decision_note: The client specifies the display cutout, cover-only display mounting, and ease-of-connection and cover-installation acceptance conditions for the enclosure design.
The client explicitly leaves the display size and resulting cutout dimensions unresolved between 2.1 and 4.2 inches.
The probable 4.2-inch display materially narrows the enclosure design direction but remains tentative, leaving the final display cutout unresolved.
